examples.trans: I grew up in a communal flat.

examples.text: Слушай, Нина, это же тот самый ресторан!
examples.trans: Listen, Nina, this is that very restaurant!

examples.text: Мы рады видеть вас в нашем ресторане.
examples.trans: We are glad to see you in our restaurant.

meanings.en: other forms: меня (gen/acc), мне (dat), мной (instr), мне (prep)

meanings.note: the present tense is normally left out: я мэр = I am the mayor
present есть; у меня есть = I have

examples.trans: You will be asking for forgiveness.

контролировать.gloss: to control, to keep an eye on

meanings.en: to supervise, to keep an eye on, to control

examples.trans: I'm supposed to keep an eye on you!
Keep an eye on me right here!

meanings.en: to switch off, turn off (device, light)

examples.trans: The subscriber is switched off! What a nightmare!
Don't forget to turn off the light.

meanings.note: сказать лишнего = to say too much

examples.trans: Yesterday I said too much to you.
Do you have a spare ticket?

meanings.note: colloquial: нет света = the power is off
в целом свете = in the whole world

meanings.en: other forms: нас (gen/acc), нам (dat), нами (instr), нас (prep)

meanings.note: 'взять на работу' = to give someone a job

examples.trans: There are so many mistakes there!
I don't have that much time.

meanings.note: plural only: there is no singular in everyday use

examples.trans: The money is on the table.

meanings.note: неделю = for a week; через неделю = in a week
the imperative 'слушай' starts a sentence, like 'look, ...'

examples.text: Я бы на твоём месте подумал.
examples.trans: If I were you, I'd think about it.

meanings.note: plural-only noun: эти часы = this watch
+ dative of the buyer: 'продать соседке' = to sell to the neighbour

examples.trans: I'll sell it to the neighbour.

нельзя.gloss: it is not allowed; one can't

meanings.note: points at something: это моё = that's mine

meanings.en: other forms: этого, этому, это, этим, этом
other forms: тебя (gen/acc), тебе (dat), тобой (instr), тебе (prep)

meanings.note: used with не before the verb, or alone

examples.text: Я никогда не был на море.
examples.trans: I've never been to the sea.

meanings.note: goes right before the word it negates
at home, a party, or a restaurant

examples.trans: All the guests love them very much.

examples.text: Сегодня вечером к нам придут гости.
examples.trans: Guests are coming to our place tonight.

meanings.note: с первого раза = the first time

examples.text: Ты не понимаешь с первого раза?
examples.trans: You don't understand the first time?

meanings.note: the end of a quarrel or war
the plural is used only in this sense

examples.text: Мы сделали много, но надо ещё.
examples.trans: We've done a lot, but we need more.
I want to, but I can't.
I love our town very much.

meanings.en: it is necessary, one needs to
meanings.note: + dative of the person + infinitive: мне нужно позвонить

examples.trans: I need to make a call.

meanings.note: the comparative 'быстрее', often as an order

достать.gloss: to take out, to get, to reach

meanings.en: to take out, to pull out, to reach
to get hold of, to obtain

examples.trans: And take his eye out with a spoon.
He took his phone out of his pocket.

meanings.en: way, method, means of doing something

examples.text: Сильный ищет способ, а слабый ищет причину.
examples.trans: The strong man looks for a way, and the weak man looks for an excuse.

examples.text: Мы нашли простой способ решить задачу.
examples.trans: We found a simple way to solve the problem.

meanings.note: не клади трубку = don't hang up

examples.trans: Where do you put the keys?
We need to do even more.

examples.text: Мы посидим на льду и половим рыбу.
examples.trans: We will sit on the ice and catch fish.
In winter the river became covered with thick ice.

meanings.note: at the start of a question

examples.trans: So I shouldn't wait for you?

meanings.note: на днях = in the next few days, or the other day

examples.trans: I'll call in the next few days.
In a day you can save a lot.
